item.tib: gshen rab rnam par rgyal ba las sbyin sreg tshangs pa'i nor bu 'od 'bar
item.coloph: rnam mkhyen 'gro ba'i don la rab dgongs nas/ rgyal ba'i mdzad pa nam mkha'i char zil tsam/ gzhung lugs pad mo zlum pa kha 'byed pa/ dmu rigs nyi ma'i ming can bdag gis brtsams/ brtsams pa'i mchod sbyin dge ba gang mchis de/ de nyid 'gro ba yongs su kun khyab nas/ nas 'phel bzhin du yongs su rab dar zhing / zhing mchog gcig gi rgyan gcig thob par shog sbyin sreg tshangs pa'i nor bu 'od 'bar zhes bya ba/ nye bar mkho ba'i lag len bde blag tu bstan pa yin no/ bkra shis dge mtshan sa steng khyab 'gyur cig/
